lines.arrive: Your study. On the desk, something you built: a little world, running.
lines.look: Tiny people, living tiny lives. To them, it's all real.
lines.nested: And in their world, someone is building one too.
lines.more: One world can run many. And each of those can run more.
lines.ask: If worlds like this are easy to make, how many are real? And which kind is yours?
lines.pullout: Somewhere, someone may be looking at you the same way.
lines.off_end: You switch them off. Above you, the lights flicker.
lines.run_end: You let them run. Maybe someone is doing the same for you.
lines.window: Outside, the sky. You've never actually checked how far it goes.
lines.photo: A photo of you as a child. You don't remember it being taken.
